suppress.notes: CVE-2026-54522 is a defect in MessagePack for Ruby — the buffer.c C extension of the Ruby gem (rmem page pool reuse in MessagePack::Buffer#clear). Dependency-check matches it onto org.msgpack/msgpack, the unrelated Java library this project gets transitively through com.cognitect/transit-java. Same product name, different codebase, different language. Suppressed for that CVE and that artifact only.
